integrity.proof_basis: local nine-pair enumeration, transfer invariant, 2-by-2 Cayley-Hamilton identity
integrity.verification: two independent standard-library programs with captured outputs; exhaustive finite tests are auxiliary, not all-size proof

scientific_limitations: Exact result restricted to immediate primitive period-three states of the three-state threshold-one Greenberg-Hastings map on labelled vertex-glued triangular cactus chains. No claim about transient basins, other lengths of orbits, other cacti, or other alphabet sizes. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed/equivalent-formulation literature.
title: A two-state recurrence for three-periodic excitation on triangular cactus chains
